BILL NUMBER:  S5156

 TITLE OF BILL :  An act to amend chapter 577 of the laws of 2006,
amending the Greenwood Lake Protection Act and the state finance law,
relating to establishing certain fees, reporting requirements and the
Greenwood Lake protection fund, in relation to the effectiveness
thereof

 PURPOSE :  To authorize the Greenwood Lake Commission to charge fees
for the usage of boats and docks.

 SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS :  Section 1 amends section 4 of chapter 577 of
the laws of 2006.

 JUSTIFICATION :  The Greenwood Lake Commission currently has no
source of revenue. By allowing the Commission to charge fees for the
usage of boats and docks this legislation will provide the Commission
with the ability to perform its duties more effectively. Section 4 of
chapter 577 of the laws of 2006 expires on June 30, 2008. This bill
authorizes the Greenwood Lake Commission to charge fees for the usage
of boats and docks for without an expiration date.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :

2008 S.8552/Passed Senate

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS : To be determined

 EFFECTIVE DATE :  This act shall take effect upon enactment into law
by the state of New Jersey of legislation having substantially similar
effect with this act, but if the state of New Jersey shall have
already enacted such legislation, this act shall take effect
immediately; provided further that Greenwood Lake commission shall
notify the legislative bill drafting commission upon the occurrence of
the enactment of the legislation provided for in this act in order
that the legislative bill drafting commission may maintain an accurate
and timely effective database of the official text of the law of the
state of New York in furtherance of effecting the provisions of
section 44 of the legislative law and section 70-b of the public
officers law.

BILL NUMBER:  S5156A

 TITLE OF BILL :
An act to amend chapter 577 of the laws of 2006, amending the
Greenwood Lake Protection Act and the state finance law, relating to
establishing certain fees, reporting requirements and the Greenwood
Lake protection fund, in relation to the effectiveness thereof

 PURPOSE :
To authorize the Greenwood Lake Commission to charge fees for the
usage of boats and docks.

 SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS :
Section 1 amends section 4 of chapter 577 of the laws of 2006 relating
to establishing certain fees, reporting requirements and the Greenwood
Lake Protection Fund.   JUSTIFICATION :
The Greenwood Lake Commission currently has no source of revenue. By
allowing the Commission to charge fees for the usage of boats and
docks this legislation will provide the Commission with the ability to
perform its duties more effectively. This bill will extend Chapter 577
of the laws of 2006 until June 30, 2011.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :
2008 S.8552/Passed Senate

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :
To be determined.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
Immediately.

summary: Amends chapter 577 of the laws of 2006 relating to the Greenwood Lake protection act; eliminates the June 30, 2008 expiration.
